questions: Did the bruising around your eyes begin after an injury to your head, face, or nose?
Have you had any facial, nasal, eyelid, or cosmetic procedure recently?
Did you lose consciousness, feel confused, or have a memory gap after any recent injury?
Have you had a severe or worsening headache since this began?
Have you vomited since this began?
Do you have blurred or double vision?
Do you have pain when moving either eye?
Is either eye difficult to open because of swelling?
Have you noticed blood or clear fluid coming from your nose or ears?
Do you have fever, increasing redness, warmth, or tenderness around either eye?
Did the discoloration appear suddenly without any known injury or procedure?
Do you bruise or bleed unusually easily elsewhere?
Are you taking blood thinners, aspirin, or medications that affect clotting?
Do you have a known bleeding or platelet disorder?

served: lid position and measurement (MRD1 both sides)
results: 1. lid position and measurement (MRD1 both sides): MRD1 raised on the LEFT (retraction); right lid height normal - the right eye is NOT ptotic
2. TSH / free T4 / TRAb: normal, TRAb negative - excludes thyroid eye disease
3. surgical history: closed-approach structural rhinoplasty; retraction noted on postoperative day 6
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acquired unilateral left upper-eyelid retraction secondary to recent closed-approach structural rhinoplasty (postoperative periorbital soft-tissue/levator-aponeurosis traction), with associated postoperative periorbital ecchymosis.

ALTERNATIVES:  
1. Direct postoperative levator muscle or levator-aponeurosis injury causing persistent left upper-lid retraction.  
2. Orbital hemorrhage or edema related to the rhinoplasty.  
3. Idiopathic or neurogenic unilateral upper-eyelid retraction.
